rows.en:
(Okay, next is Hilda-sensei's P.E.
I've gotta give it my all!)

Hm, \p.
You look fired up today.
Yes! Please look after us in class again today!
Mm. But in P.E. today, we're fixing up the schoolyard.
Huh... Is that right...

Yes. The field's gotten rough, and there are weeds.
At this rate, some student could end up getting hurt.
That's true, I guess...
Save that fighting spirit for the next class, got it?
(Too bad about class, but I'll give it my all next time!)

(Okay, next is Hilda-sensei's P.E.
Time to do my best!)
(Too bad about class, but I'll do my best next time!)
(Okay, I came out into town today, but... now what...)
Hey, \p. What's up?
Huh?! What? Hilda-sensei...?
What's with that face?
Oh, it's just... you're not in your tracksuit today...
You... Are you picking a fight with me?
Ah, I didn't mean it like that at all...

Just you wait till the next class!
You're getting a special workout, just for you!
(N-no way...)
(That's not what I meant at all...)
(Okay, I came out into town today, but... what to do...)
Oh?! Huh? Hilda-sensei...?
Oh, I just thought... you're not in your tracksuit today?
Ah, I really didn't mean it like that...
(N-no waaay...)
(That's not what I meant at all, though...)
(Okay, next up is Hilda-sensei's swimming class.)
All right, are you done warming up?
Yes, I already finished.

Good, that'll do.
Then let's start with 500m. Go!
What?! 500 meters?

Hm? Was that a bit too little?
Then let's make it 1000m.

Sensei, w-wait a second!
How many laps of this pool would that even be...

What, you can't even do that math?
Even a grade-schooler can do that division. Pathetic.
No, that's not what I mean...
Come on, get moving. 50m.
Honestly, you can't take a joke at all. Go on!
(Hilda-sensei's jokes are really hard to read...)
(Okay, next up is Hilda-sensei's swimming class.)
What?! Did you say 500 meters?
No, that's not what I meant...
(Hilda-sensei's jokes are just so hard to read...)

(Let's see, next is Hilda-sensei's
Health and P.E. class, right?)
Phew... This really is tough...
Hilda-sensei? What's wrong?

Well, normally the P.E. teachers split
the Health and P.E. classes between them...
But the other one is... well, you know...
Ah, Gary-sensei...

I can hardly let him teach some half-baked class,
so I've taken them all on myself.
...That sounds rough...

Well, yes. Though classroom lectures
aren't my strong suit either...
Thanks for all your hard work...
(Sensei's got it tough in all sorts of ways too, huh...)

(Okay, next is Hilda-sensei's
Health and P.E. class, isn't it?)
Oh, you mean Gary-sensei...
(Sensei's got it tough in all kinds of ways too...)
(Okay, lunchtime... Huh? Hilda-sensei.)
Hilda-sensei, are you having lunch now?

Wh-what, \p?
What are you doing in a place like this...?

Oh, I thought I'd get some fresh air before lunch...
Huh, you brought a packed lunch, Sensei?
Hm, well, yes, but...

That's a really cute lunch.
It's arranged so nicely, too...
Where do they sell lunches like that?
...made... it...
rows.notes: Mumbled fragment of 'tezukuri' (homemade); the next Hilda line says it in full.

rows.en: Huh? What was that?
rows.notes: x6: also scd_fes_807 (after Grace mutters); fits both.

rows.en: I... made it myself...

Oh, really!
That's a surprise!
Hey, you. Did you just say "surprise"?

No, I didn't say anything like...
Oh, I'll be going nooow!

(Phew, that was close...
But who knew Hilda-sensei had such a surprising talent...)
(Okay, lunchtime... Huh? Hilda-sensei.)

Oh, I thought I'd get some fresh air before lunch...
Oh, so you brought a packed lunch, Sensei.

What a cute lunch.
It's arranged so nicely, too...
Where do they sell lunches like that?

(Phew, that was close...
But Hilda-sensei has a surprising talent, huh...)
